values.binNote: The bonus true-damage-vs-max-health term scales with Aurelion Sol's Stardust buffStacks (AurelionSolQ.QMaxHealthTrueDamagePerStack x buffStacks), a passive-stack-dependent value the wiki table does not fully break out; treated here as a flat per-stack coefficient since the stack count is not a rank number.

values.quote: the beam will deal a burst of {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} for each full second that it burns them

mechanics.claim: The beam continuously ticks damage to the first enemy hit every 0.125 seconds, and deals only 50% damage to other enemies caught in the beam.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and surrounding enemies every {{fd|0.125}} seconds. Secondary targets are dealt 50% damage.

mechanics.claim: A note contradicts the description, stating the burn timer ticks in 0.2 second intervals with the burst triggering at 5 completed intervals (1 full second) rather than 0.125 second ticks.
mechanics.quote: ''Breath of Light's'' burn places a timer on the primary target, which ticks in {{fd|0.2}} second intervals. Thus, at{{ft|5 completed intervals,|1 full second,}}the burst damage is triggered.

mechanics.claim: The primary-target burn timer resets to zero (losing progress toward the next burst) if the target is not hit again within 1 second of no longer being burned.
mechanics.quote: It falls off and resets to zero if a target is not hit within 1 second of no longer being afflicted by the burn.

mechanics.claim: The beam and burst damage are separate persistent damage instances (beam is persistent area damage, burst is persistent damage), relevant for on-hit/proc interactions.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|persistent damage}} on the burst and {{tip|persistent area damage}} on the beam.

mechanics.claim: Spell Shield only blocks the burst component of the ability, not the continuous beam damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the burst damage.

mechanics.claim: Casting/steering Breath of Light can be recast to end it early, and it automatically recasts (ends) at the end of its duration.
mechanics.quote: ''Breath of Light'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not begin until the channel ends.
